messages:
Cassie: Not trying to commandeer the calendar, but my birthday is next Wednesday. Low-key is perfect  if anyone wants to swing by with a slice or a silly hat, you're welcome :blush:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Post birthday plans and sign-ups in #people-ops. Shared sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bday-helpers
Theo: I can bring mini pizzas (WFH option: tiny gift card). Quick react poll: :pizza: pizzas, :seedling: plant, :cupcake: cupcakes, :gift: e-gift.
Rina: If pizza, can we do one vegetarian and one gluten-free box? I can order.
Omar: I volunteer to MC a 5-min Roast & Toast segment at 3:10pm PT (light-hearted). Remote folks can drop 5-8s clips in the folder.
Jess: I can make a silly party hat (paper) and a one-liner for the card! Also happy to coordinate shipping for remotes.
Cassie: No roast please, only toasts with gentle teasing allowed ;)
people-ops-bot: people-ops ledger: suggested per-person contribution $5-20. Sign-up updated: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bday-helpers (last edit 1830002562)
Theo: Snapshot poll 1:45pm PT  :pizza: 11, :seedling: 2, :cupcake: 3, :gift: 1  pizzas win. Ordering now, pick-up 2:50pm.
Rina: Ordering two boxes: one veg + one GF. ETA office 3pm.
Jess: Card lines here: "Happy birthday Cassie! May your PRs pass on the first try."
Omar: "Thanks for always bringing snacks to calls when production thinks it's fun."
Cassie: You absolute dorks. Thank you. See you for the 3pm 10-min pizza mingle (and remote folks, drop clips in the folder) :heart:
